title: Wild Camping Adventure
description: A lakeside hike goes sideways when a raccoon makes off with the Yeti’s backpack.
panels: At sunrise in the mountains, the Yeti raises a blue can. “New day! New trails! New drinks!” A sign points toward adventure.
He hikes past a sign marked “Beautiful Lake,” singing about hiking, drinking, exploring and living.
At the lake he sits on a stump and says, “This is perfect.”
A raccoon grabs the backpack. “Hey! My backpack!” the Yeti calls. “Mission accomplished!” says the raccoon.
The two meet again by a cooler. A sign picks “Great idea!” for a drinking contest. The Yeti raises his can. “Let’s do this!”
They fall asleep beside the fire. A sign reads, “Good company anywhere.”

title: Trail Mix
description: The Yeti asks his hiking buddy what goes into a proper trail mix.
panels: “What’s in the trail mix?” the Yeti asks the raccoon.
The raccoon mixes pebbles, a pine cone, and a trail sign into the bag.
“Needs more trail,” says the Yeti. The raccoon offers him a boot.

title: The Shortcut
description: A shortcut turns into a very long walk.
panels: “I know a shortcut,” the Yeti says at a fork.
The two trudge up switchbacks past a mountain goat.
They return to the same sign after dark. “We cut out the scenery,” says the Yeti.

title: Fish Story
description: Something from the bottom of the lake is tugging at the line.
panels: Fishing from a dock with the raccoon, the Yeti calls out, “I feel a big one!”
He reels in an old boot.
A tiny fish peeks out of the boot and says, “Knock first.”

title: Tent for Two
description: The Yeti packs light for a night under the stars.
panels: The Yeti unrolls a tiny tent. “It sleeps two.”
He tries to squeeze inside while the raccoon watches.
The tent only covers the Yeti’s blue feet. “Two feet,” says the raccoon.

title: Echo Chamber
description: The Yeti has a question for the canyon.
panels: “Who’s the king of the mountain?” the Yeti shouts over the canyon.
The Yeti and raccoon wait in silence.
An echo answers, “Please hold.”

title: The Ferry
description: A river crossing costs one stick apiece.
panels: A beaver in a captain’s hat says, “One stick each.”
The Yeti offers a pine tree.
As his passengers float away on a log, the beaver waves. “Keep the change.”

title: The Northern Lights
description: The Yeti raises a toast to the aurora.
panels: The raccoon points at the green aurora. “Nature’s happy hour,” says the Yeti.
The Yeti lifts his can to the sky. “I’ll have what she’s having.”
The raccoon hands him a snowball. “On the rocks. Nice,” says the Yeti.

title: Hot Springs
description: A dip in an alpine pool comes with unexpected company.
panels: The Yeti finds a hot spring. “This one feels perfect.”
He settles in. The raccoon spots carrots and onions in the water.
A moose in an apron asks, “Could you scoot? I need to stir.”

title: Trail Cam
description: The Yeti spots a wildlife camera and gets ready for his close-up.
panels: The raccoon spots a trail camera. “Act natural,” says the Yeti.
The Yeti strikes a glamour pose. The raccoon facepalms.
A ranger looks at the photo. “That’s our third model this week.”

title: Postcard Home
description: From the summit, the Yeti sends a postcard to someone special.
panels: On the summit, the Yeti writes, “Wish you were here.”
The card is for the blue cooler at the bottom of the mountain.
At sunset, the Yeti reunites with the cooler. “He knows. He was there,” says the raccoon.
